title: Structural query probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $\alpha$ be a label set, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates. For a coordinate $i$, its structural query probability is zero at a leaf; at a query node it is one if that node queries $i$, and otherwise it is the $\pi$-expectation of the structural query probability in the child selected by the sampled alphabet value.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
the tree has an available-coordinate set
